prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult South African woman — the personification of Cape Town — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Cape Town as her world knows it — a storybook gaslamp-fantasy city: gleaming brass, polished wood, glass, silk, lace and feathers, clockwork details, warm gaslight and soft white steam — clean, warm and storybook-bright, never sooty, rusty or grimy. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Place: a sloping lawn in a botanical garden at the foot of the great mountain on a summer evening, picnic rugs among giant protea flowers and a little band playing beneath a brass-and-glass bandstand.
Around her, as her world makes them: a waxed canvas groundsheet; a thick pressed-glass tumbler; a single giant king protea flower head with silvery pale pink bracts, its stem wrapped in lace and ribbon.
Season: summer — December to March, warm, dry and sunny, the strong south-east wind blowing for days and the tablecloth of cloud lying on the mountain.
Weather: the Cape Doctor blowing — a strong, dry south-easter under a clear sky, hair and hems whipping and the air washed clean.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Outfit: a heavy velvet evening dress with a deep sheen — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a close, neatly tailored fit and delicate drop earrings, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress of a storybook gaslamp city — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of cotton, fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather, with brass buttons, buckles and hooks, silk ribbons and laced boots, neat and clean.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand holds a V sign over one eye, that eye peeking out between her two spread fingers — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a brass marine chronometer in an open polished mahogany box — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, bomber jacket, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.
